role.title: Role within the technical staff
role.text:
My role is developed as an active part of the technical staff, coordinating the goalkeeper's work with the game model, the physical process, and performance analysis.

Goalkeeper training is not approached as an isolated task, but as a component integrated into the team's collective functioning.

criteria.title: Intervention approach
criteria.text:
I intervene based on game analysis and the real demands of competition, prioritising decision-making, reading situations, and contextualised execution.

The focus of the work is on preparing the goalkeeper to respond effectively in real scenarios, not on reproducing gestures in a decontextualised way.

methodology.title: Methodology
methodology.intro: My approach is built on game analysis as a cross-cutting axis, developed through diagnostic evaluation and decision-making, integrating technical, tactical and cognitive aspects in real competitive environments.

1.title: Game analysis
1.text: Match-play analysis defines objectives and guides analytical, mixed and contextualized tasks throughout the process.

2.title: Diagnostic evaluation
2.text: Initial assessment is essential to build the work plan and address the goalkeeper's predominant needs at each stage.

3.title: Video analysis
3.text: A key tool to identify strengths and weaknesses, support the process, and improve game understanding.

4.title: Cognitive work
4.text: Training aimed at constant improvement in Perception, Decision-making and Execution as part of the daily methodology.

5.title: Technical-tactical integration & coordination
5.text: Technique is used as a training tool to enhance tactical behaviors, in coordination with the head coach and physical department.
